12Oxygen Concentrators

12Oxygen Concentrators

Concentrators deliver 90–95% oxygen at flows up to 10 L/min. Above that flow the purity falls off. There are 5 levels of service.

Exam anchorPurity drops below 90% past 10 L/min.
